upsert.title: NEAR Hackathon 2026: Build Beyond Boundaries
upsert.summary: Two-week online build across 13 tracks (DeFi, Private AI, AI swarms, agent economy, games and more). Public repo and X demo required.
upsert.eligibility: Open to anyone; no sign-up needed. Solo or team, one submission per team.

prize.description: US$250,000 paid in NEAR: US$55,000 grand prize; 13 tracks each paying US$10,000 / US$3,000 / US$2,000.

notes: Build window opens 1 Nov 2026 00:00 UTC; judging 16–18 Nov.

upsert.title: Google Quantum AI: Verifiable Quantum Circuit Compilation
upsert.summary: Kaggle competition on compiling quantum circuits with verifiable results. No quantum physics background required per the organizers.
upsert.eligibility: Kaggle account holders aged 18+, worldwide except Crimea, DNR, LNR, Cuba, Iran, North Korea and US-sanctioned persons. Teams of up to 5.

prize.description: US$150,000: 1st US$50,000, 2nd US$25,000, 3rd US$10,000, 4th–6th US$5,000 each, plus milestone, longest-leader and single-task prizes.

notes: Join and merge teams by 13 Jan 2027.

upsert.title: Since AI Hackathon 2026
upsert.summary: 72-hour in-person AI hackathon at EduCity, Turku, Finland (6–8 Nov) with 15 company challenges and responsible-AI and commercial-potential awards.
upsert.eligibility: Builders worldwide above the legal age of majority. Application and acceptance required; applications reviewed on a rolling basis. Free.

prize.description: EUR 50,000: grand prize EUR 10,000, 15 company awards of EUR 2,000, plus EUR 4,000 / 3,000 / 3,000 special awards.

notes: Apply early; the page says registration stays open until the event begins but also lists 6 Nov as the deadline.

upsert.title: TUM Blockchain & AI Hackathon 2026
upsert.summary: 30-hour in-person build sprint in Munich with about 200 builders on blockchain and AI, with agentic payments as the theme. Part of the TUM Blockchain Conference.
upsert.eligibility: Open worldwide, not limited to TUM students. Solo or teams of up to 5; each member applies separately on Devfolio. Free, though a deposit may be announced.

prize.description: EUR 10,000: EUR 4,000 from BSV Association and EUR 6,000 from Cardano; per-place breakdown not yet published.

notes: Build starts 30 Oct; submissions close 31 Oct.

upsert.title: Arbitrum Open House Dubai: Online Buildathon
upsert.summary: Online buildathon on HackQuest for products built with Stylus or Solidity on Arbitrum One or an Orbit chain; new or existing products allowed.
upsert.eligibility: Developers, creators and founders. Team size not specified.

prize.description: US$30,000; breakdown not announced and prizes may change if submissions miss the quality bar.

notes: Registration 31 Oct – 5 Dec; submissions open 16 Nov; rewards announced 13 Dec.

upsert.title: Smart Buildings Competition 2026 (Kaggle)
upsert.summary: Kaggle code competition on smart-building control with a NeurIPS 2026 workshop paper track. Run as notebooks with up to 9 hours and no internet.
upsert.deadlineLabel: Final submissions and papers (15 Jan 2027 23:59 UTC)
upsert.eligibility: Kaggle users aged 18+ worldwide except Crimea, DNR, LNR, Cuba, Iran, North Korea and sanctioned persons. Teams of up to 5.

prize.description: US$40,000: US$25,000 across eight leaderboard places (US$5,750 down to US$2,500) and US$15,000 paper track.

notes: Poster paper deadline 13 Nov 2026; last day to join teams 3 Jan 2027.
